chunks: And his wife, the portress of fire wood,
ai.seo_question: Who is the 'portress of fire wood' mentioned in Surah Al-Masad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase specifically identifies Umm Jamil (often identified as Arwa bint Harb) as the one who physically scattered thorns and dry branches in the Prophet's path to hinder his movement and spread his name. This act of 'carrying wood' (hammalat al-hatab) is viewed not merely as a chore but as a symbolic preparation of the 'fuel' for her own entry into the Hellfire mentioned in the same verse, illustrating the direct link between her actions and divine retribution.
